checks: Explicit Save is available before manual verification; cancel never writes or clears the draft
Source Save automatically verifies its immutable snapshot and rereads the saved document
A stale preview cannot be reused; direct Save validates the newer draft instead
Reload requires a deliberate discard; cancellation and read failure retain the draft, successful reload clears it
During native writing, target selection, edit, undo, reload and navigation cannot alter the saving document; editing resumes after completion
Validation and write failures preserve the exact draft; explicit retry succeeds without weakening native gates
